# Taskfile support

Adopt the "Taskfile" convention — a plain bash script with one function per task, invoked as `./Taskfile <task>` — as the lightweight alternative to a Makefile for small projects:

```
- add alias = run
- add tests helper
```

The `run` alias makes `run build`, `run tests` work in any project that has a Taskfile; the tests helper is a function that discovers `test_*` functions and reports their results, so that a Taskfile can carry smoke tests without a framework. The repository notes cite [adriancooney/Taskfile](https://github.com/adriancooney/Taskfile) as the origin of the idea.
